class_imbalance_handling: RandomForest class_weight='balanced_subsample'; LogisticRegression class_weight='balanced'. No oversampling.
training_notes: Preprocessor is fit on training rows only. Features are float32. When the training set is larger than 100,000 rows, each random forest tree is grown on a 100,000-row sample with max_depth 24, using two workers, so the model fits in 8 GB of memory. Evaluation still uses the full held-out test set. Logistic regression is the linear comparison model and sees every training row.
